title: DIVINE BENEFIT
subtitle: Daily Benefits Devotional Guide
author: Bishop (Evang) Roseline Matthew

memory_verse.text:
And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve
years.

divine_benefits:
There is hope for you, no matter what you are passing
through now.

That situation will not destroy you, but create the gate way
for a major testimony in your life.
entries.condition:
Take deliberate steps of faith towards God
with all your heart and trust Him enough to obey His
instructions no matter the cost. And at last, he will turn your
mourning into a lasting joy.
entries.prayer:
Lord, help me to take deliberate steps of faith
towards you with all my heart and teach me to obey your
instructions no matter the cost from this day in Jesus
name.
entries.prophetic_words:
Your story will surely change for
the best as you hold unto God by faith. You will surely stand
out for the work of change He has started in your life from this
day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 7 EVENING: JUDGES 5-6

memory_verse.text:
And had suffered many things of many physicians and had
spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather
grew worse

divine_benefits:
No matter what you have passed through, there is good news
for you.

Jesus is passing through your route to settle your case in any
area you really need Him.
entries.condition:
Turn the case to the Lord with strong prayer of
faith, and with your heart ready to obey every divine
instructions without any distraction and surely heaven will
respond positively to your case.
entries.prayer:
Lord teach me to turn my case to you with the
prayer of faith with my heart ready to obey every divine
instructions from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
Your prayer of faith will never be
turn down by God. You are in your days of lasting Solution and
your life will be a living proof that God answers prayers from
this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 8 EVENING: JUDGES 7-8

memory_verse.text:
When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind,
and touched his garment

divine_benefits: The news of victory is coming your way.

The grace to take the steps that leads to success and joy in
life is on you.
entries.condition:
Put aside every obstacle and press forward
by faith towards God with all your heart, with all you are, and
with all you have, and then you will definitely see yourself in
the land of miracles.
entries.prayer:
Lord, I receive grace to put aside every
obstacle and truly press by faith towards you until my
need is met from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
Receive grace to take the right
steps at the right time of your miracle and many shall hear and
see the wonders of God over your life from this day in Jesus
name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 9:1-29 EVENING: JUDGES 9

memory_verse.text: For she said, if I may touch but His clothes I shall be whole.

divine_benefits: Heaven is ready to respond to you when you call

The Lord shall heal every part that needed healing in your
life and you shall be completely whole.
entries.condition:
Lift up your eyes by faith towards the Lord,
and take steps that is in line with His word, don't be discourage
neither be distracted from Him until you handle your result
and truly you will be a testimony to your world that God is
faithful.
entries.prayer:
Lord, teach me to lift up my eyes by faith
towards you without getting discouraged or distracted
from you until I handle my results from this day in Jesus
name.
entries.prophetic_words:
Your life shall begin to command
divine results that will compel many to serve the Lord from
this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 9:30-50 EVENING: JUDGES 10-12

memory_verse.text:
And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up;
and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

divine_benefits:
The power from above will come on you and dry up every
fountain of problems the enemies has brought into your life.

Every plague around your life has been destroyed by the
Lord.
entries.condition:
It is your steps of faith towards God that
really move Him into doing wonders, if you really want to
enjoy His wondrous works, make real steps of faith towards
Him and you shall smile at last.
entries.prayer:
Lord, help me to make steps of faith towards
you so that I can enjoy your wonders in my life from this
day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
You are reborn in Christ to
produce great results, no power will stop you from this day in
Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 10:1-31 EVENING: JUDGES 13-14

memory_verse.text:
And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had
gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, who
touched my clothes?

divine_benefits:
Heaven will recognize your touch of faith and respond to you
without delay.

Your faith will compel heaven to release your miracle to the
surprise of men.
entries.condition:
Make up your mind to take unusual steps (that is
not against God's word) towards the kingdom that will compel
heaven to stand up on your behalf until you become what He has
destined you to be on earth and in the world to come you will not
also loose out.
entries.prayer:
Lord, teach me to deliberately take unusual steps
that is in line with your word until I am fulfilled to your glory
from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
The plan and the purpose of God for
your life will surely stand. You are created to stand out and to be a
praise to God on earth, receive grace to enjoy divine arrangement
for your life in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 10:32-52 EVENING: JUDGES 15-17

memory_verse.text:
And his disciples said unto him, thou seest the multitude
thronging thee, and sayest thou, who touched me?

divine_benefits:
God will release unexpected miracle into your life that will
cause embarrassment in the midst of men.

Your faith will compel heaven to do some strange miracles that
will command attraction on every side.
entries.condition:
Recognize divine opportunities and grab them
without delay, that could be the very time you have been waiting
for. It is your responds of faith to divine opportunities that create
a large room for miracles and testimonies. Be wise and be
vigilant enough to recognize them, and you will be the wisest
among others.
entries.prayer:
Lord, help me to be at alert spiritually to recognize
divine opportunities so that I can grab them without delay
from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
It is your turn to be the next goodnews
your world will begin to spread and many shall hear and celebrate
with you from this day in name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 11 EVENING: JUDGES 18-19

memory_verse.text:
And he looked round about to see her that had done this

divine_benefits: Heaven will look on you with the eyes of favour.

Divine favour shall differentiate and raise you above your

entries.condition:
Be brave and push off every obstacle to your
faith in God and match forward with your sincere service to

time.
entries.prayer:
Lord, give me a brave heart to push off every
obstacle to my faith in you so that I can constantly render
sincere service to you until it will speak for me in your
presence from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
Your faith in God is bringing you
to the front in life where many will see and be challenged to
serve God with all sincerity and faithfulness from this day in
Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 12 EVENING: JUDGES 20-21

memory_verse.text:
But the woman fearing and trembling knowing what was
done in her, came and fell down before Him, and told him all
the truth.

divine_benefits: Your miracle shall not be hidden

The Lord will do a work in your life that will command His fear
in your heart.

The miracle of God in your life shall cause you to tell the truth
about Jesus to your world.
entries.condition:
Don't be too familiar with God, rather let His fear
occupy your heart to the level it will drive away every manner of
evil and compel you to do what is right in His sight without
minding any distraction, and He will be delighted to mind you
until He brings you to the top in the journey of life.
entries.prayer:
Lord, create your fear in my heart to the level your
word will be a command in my heart from this day in Jesus
name.
entries.prophetic_words:
God is taken you from the valley of
depression to the mountain of honour and testimonies from this
day in Jesus name

That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven

The God of heaven shall surely show you mercy in the journey
of life.

God will show to you the secret that will connect you to your
destiny.

God is your covering, you will never be destroyed by the
destroyers.

Be addicted to God in love, and let nothing move
you more than Him, let your eyes be constantly fix on Him in any

nothing move me than you, so that I can constantly fix my eyes

God will raise you above every

Through you many others will be save from this day in Jesus name

Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision,
then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

divine_benefits: God will hand over to you the secret to get to the top in life.
Divine wisdom shall make you stand out above others.
God shall give you many reasons to bless His great name.

complain, stop murmuring, stop blaming people for your

memory_verse.text:
Daniel answered and said, blessed be the name of God
for ever and ever for wisdom and might are his.

divine_benefits: Your life shall constantly be a praise to the Almighty God.

Wisdom to make it in life is in the hands of God and you
belong to Him.

You belong to the God who has all power to overcome
every manner of obstacle in life.
entries.condition:
Know it, that whatever you are and
whatever you shall be is from the Lord, therefore, learn to
give Him all the glory for each victory and success you
handle so that He can be delighted to do more.
entries.prayer:
Lord, teach me to give you all the glory for
each victory and success I handle in life, I know all is
from you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
You cannot fall and you cannot
fail for God who create and owns power and wisdom is
standing by your side for success in the journey of life from
this day in Jesus name.

kings, and setteth up kings; he giveth wisdom unto the
wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding.

divine_benefits:
God is the controller of every events of the world, therefore,
your destiny is secured in Him.

God shall overthrow all your opposers and enthrone you to
rule over them.

God shall grant you the wisdom that will make you wiser
than all your enemies.
entries.condition:
Serve God with openness of heart and be
ready to stand your ground and trust Him no matter the cost
and you shall be a living proof of His power and wisdom to
your world.
entries.prayer:
Lord, help me to serve you with openness of
heart and teach me to stand my ground to truly trust you
no matter the cost from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
Your openness to God will open the
doors of victory and honour into your life from this day in
Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 3-4 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 7-8

understanding.

God's wisdom shall raise you to the platform of glory and
honour, beyond human understanding.

make it in life, you must make Him your first priority and
make His instructions your body guard that is the shortcut to
the life of comfort and success in the journey of life; If you
don't want life to walk against you, choose that way.
entries.prayer:
Lord, help me to make you my first priority
and your instructions my body guard, I don't want life
to walk against me from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
The secret of life shall be
divinely handed over to you and you shall enjoy life and
Success very cheap from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 5-6 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 9

generation.

The Lord will compel important personality to honour you

He can use you to rescue those that the enemies has destined to

entries.prayer:

entries.prophetic_words:
You carry God's presence, and His
presence in your life will cause men to bow before you and
compel them to serve your God with great fear from this day in
Jesus name.

The Lord will do a thing in your life that will cause fear in the

The God you serve is above every other gods, therefore, He

turn every situation that comes your way to God in prayers, and

leading of the Holy Spirit; the assurance of lasting victory

with the spirit of God to walk in God's way and die to selfish

He will guide you into all truth you need to know about

divine_benefits: You shall be productive through the power of the Holy Spirit.

Your life shall begin to produce love, lasting joy, peace,
patience, kindness, goodness and faithfulness.
entries.condition:
If only you can give the Holy Spirit a chance to
take full control of your heart and your life, He will surely
bring the best out of you. He does not force people to submit to
Him, it is a choice you need to make. Remember that the choice
you make today has great effect to your destiny, choose to give
Him a chance and you will be glad that you did.
entries.prayer:
Lord, I willingly submit to your spirit to have
His way in my life, teach me not to argue with Him in any
way from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:

God's goodness and your fruits shall be so attractive to your

divine_benefits:
You belong to Christ, therefore the devil cannot tamper
with your destiny.
entries.condition:
If you say you really belong to Jesus then
allow His spirit to help you destroy every evil desire that is
in your heart, He is the only one that has the power to handle
them and flush them out of your spiritual system and give
you the power to live for God and appreciate what Jesus did
for you on the cross, give the Holy Spirit a chance in your
life.
entries.prayer:
Lord, I belong to you, help me to submit to
your spirit to help me kill every evil desire in me and
teach me to live my life for you alone from this day in
Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words:
You are no more under the
control of satan, you are now under the control of Jesus,
where honour and comfort flow in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 PETER 2-3 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 21-23

Out of God's glorious and unlimited resources, He will
give all you need to reach your destination in life.

heart from this day in Jesus name.

divine_benefits:
God is your provider, you will not starve for any
reason.

God's presence into your situation, learn to trust Him,

away fear so that your peace can abide in me from

entries.prophetic_words:
Where many suffer lack, you
will gather abundance there because you belong to God
from this day in Jesus name.
